mapper.sql: P.POST_ID, P.MEMBER_ID, P.UNIV_ID, P.BOARD_ID, P.TITLE, P.CONTENT, P.CATEGORY, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.IS_BLIND, P.REPORT_COUNT, P.IS_DELETED, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME, B.BOARD_NAME, B.IS_ANONYMOUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_LIKE PL WHERE PL.POST_ID = P.POST_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_COMMENT PC WHERE PC.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND PC.IS_DELETED = 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT
FROM POST P JOIN MEMBER M ON P.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON P.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_POST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO POST ( POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, CATEGORY, VIEW_COUNT, IS_BLIND, REPORT_COUNT, IS_DELETED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, 0, 0, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE POST SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, CATEGORY = #{category}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST_LIKE (LIKE_ID, MEMBER_ID, POST_ID, PRESSED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_POST_LIKE.NEXTVAL, #{param2}, #{param1}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO POST_REPORT (REPORT_ID, MEMBER_ID, POST_ID, REASON, DETAIL, PRESSED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_POST_REPORT.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{postId}, #{reason}, #{detail}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.POST_ID, C.UNIV_ID, C.PARENT_ID, C.CONTENT, C.IS_ANONYMOUS, C.IS_DELETED, C.CREATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.POST_ID, C.UNIV_ID, C.PARENT_ID, C.CONTENT, C.IS_ANONYMOUS, C.IS_DELETED, C.CREATED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NICKNAME FROM POST_COMMENT C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON M.MEMBER_ID = MD.MEMBER_ID WHERE C.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND C.IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_POST_COMMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO POST_COMMENT ( COMMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, POST_ID, UNIV_ID, PARENT_ID, CONTENT, IS_ANONYMOUS, IS_DELETED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{memberId}, #{postId}, #{univId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{isAnonymous}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID AS imageId, POST_ID AS postId, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, IMAGE_SORT AS imageSort, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM POST_IMAGE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY IMAGE_SORT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POST_IMAGE ( IMAGE_ID, POST_ID, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_SORT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_POST_IMAGE.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageSort}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
